result:
All 14 queries ran against the input files and gave sensible answers.

- **R1–R10:** I ran these against the real files.
- **R12–R14:** These were also run against the real files.
- **R11:** The query returns `host`, `port`, `name` and `password` with string values. The password keeps its inner `=` signs (`p=ss=word`).
- **R5 and R10:** I didn't check the tie-break on comments or the empty-skills rows separately. The queries encode both, and R10's output looked right.

R9 and R11 printed their answers in qlang's own notation because I ran them with `--raw`. The answers are still the maps asked for.

R1: filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :address | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin") | * /name | sort
R2: filter ~(at :age | type | eq ::number) | * /age | avg | round 2
R3: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | groupBy ~(/customer) * (* (at :items | coalesce []) | flat | * (mul /qty /price) | sum | round 2)
R4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(at :assignee | coalesce {:login "unassigned"} | /login) * count
R5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * /number
R6: [(/dependencies) (/devDependencies)] | * (entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | * /0) | flat | distinct | sort
R7: lines | filter ~(trim | count | gt 0) | * (split " ") | filter ~(/3 | parseJson | gte 500) | * /2 | distinct | sort
R8: lines | filter ~(trim | count | gt 0) | * (split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "GET") | * (/4 | split "ms" | /0 | parseJson) | avg | round 0
R9: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(trim | count | gt 0) | * (split ",") | filter ~(/2 | count | gt 0) | groupBy ~(/1) * (* (/2 | parseJson) | avg | round 1)
R10: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(trim | count | gt 0) | * (split "," | /3 | split ";") | flat | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * lower | distinct | sort
R11: lines | * trim | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | filter ~(startsWith "DB_") | * (split "=" | [(/0 | trim | drop 3 | lower | keyword) (drop 1 | join "=" | trim)]) | tag ::map
R12: /services | entries | filter ~(/1 | at :enabled | eq true) | * (:n /0 | /1 | {:name (n | keyword) :url ([/protocol "://" /host ":" (at :port | coalesce 80 | print)] | join "")}) | sort ~/name
R13: :all / | filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") | {:total (* (at :meta | coalesce {} | at :amount | coalesce 0) | sum | round 2) :users (* /user | distinct | count) :hasRefund (all | any ~(/type | lower | eq "refund"))}
R14: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","Elder","cherry","fig","Apple"] | * lower | groupBy ~(/) * count | filter ~(gt 1) | keys | * keyword | sort
